verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a built-in Agent on the PR page. You describe a task in plain language, and it pulls repository context, generates changes, and opens a draft PR or commits directly to the branch. Graphite Chat adds in-product delegation such as summarizing changes, applying suggested fixes in one click, and diagnosing failing CI checks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the agent completes delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe what you want built or fixed in plain language, and Agents will pull context from your repository, generate the changes, and open a draft PR ready for your review.
Make direct code changes right from your PR page. Click Agent on the right side of the PR to get started.
Any changes made by the agent are committed directly to the branch and appear in the PR like any other commit.
With Graphite Chat, you can ask for context on code changes, get instant feedback, and make edits directly from the chat interface without leaving your review workflow.
Diagnose and resolve failing checks directly from your PR page with full context from your CI results.
